description: Smoke task for raycast_env: pre_task launches Raycast and waits for its process to be running and registered with LaunchServices. The verifier passes when the Raycast process is running with a registered LaunchServices entry. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (DMG install + .app launch + verifier scaffolding) and to give a known-good interactive view via `gym-anything run … -i --open-vnc`.
natural_language: Wait. Raycast is launched before the agent gets control; no action is required.
